# proxmox_sdn_controller (Resource)

Manages a Proxmox VE SDN controller through `/cluster/sdn/controllers`. Supported types are `bgp`, `evpn`, `faucet` and `isis`. Controllers stage like the other SDN objects and only take effect when `proxmox_sdn_apply` commits.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

# Controllers stay staged until proxmox_sdn_apply commits the SDN
# configuration. EVPN zones reference them through `controller`.
# Provider credentials need SDN.Allocate on /sdn/controllers.

resource "proxmox_sdn_controller" "bgp" {
  controller = "bgp1"
  type       = "bgp"
  node       = "node1"
  asn        = 65000
  peers      = ["10.0.0.2", "10.0.0.3"]
  loopback   = "lo"
}

resource "proxmox_sdn_controller" "evpn" {
  controller = "evpn1"
  type       = "evpn"
  asn        = 65000
  peers      = ["10.0.0.2"]
  fabric     = "fabric1"
}

resource "proxmox_sdn_controller" "isis" {
  controller  = "isis1"
  type        = "isis"
  node        = "node1"
  isis_domain = "lab"
  isis_net    = "49.0001.1111.1111.1111.00"
  isis_ifaces = ["eth1", "eth2"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `controller` (String) Controller identifier: starts with a letter, letters/digits/`-`/`_`, 2 to 64 characters. Changes require replacement.
- `type` (String) Controller type: `bgp`, `evpn`, `faucet`, or `isis`. Changes require replacement.

### Optional

- `asn` (Number) Local autonomous system number. Required for `bgp` and `evpn`.
- `bgp_mode` (String) `evpn` BGP mode: `auto` (Proxmox default), `external`, or `internal`.
- `bgp_multipath_as_path_relax` (Boolean) Consider equal-length AS paths for multipath computation (`bgp` only).
- `ebgp` (Boolean) Enable eBGP (`bgp` only).
- `ebgp_multihop` (Number) Maximum eBGP hop count, 1 to 255.
- `fabric` (String) SDN fabric used as the underlay of an `evpn` controller.
- `isis_domain` (String) IS-IS domain name. Required for `isis`.
- `isis_ifaces` (Set of String) Interfaces where IS-IS is active. Required for `isis`.
- `isis_net` (String) IS-IS network entity title. Required for `isis`.
- `loopback` (String) Loopback interface providing the router IP.
- `node` (String) Node the controller runs on. Required for `bgp` and `isis`.
- `nodes` (Set of String) Nodes the `evpn` controller is active on.
- `peer_group_name` (String) BGP peer group name of an `evpn` controller; Proxmox defaults to `VTEP`.
- `peers` (Set of String) Peer IP addresses. Required for `bgp`.
- `route_map_in` (String) Route map applied to incoming routes.
- `route_map_out` (String) Route map applied to outgoing routes.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Controller identifier (same as `controller`).
- `pending` (Map of String) Properties Proxmox currently reports as staged but not committed, with `deleted` for removals.
- `state` (String) Proxmox staging state: `new` or `changed` while the controller is not committed yet.
